_comment: The AgentHarness declaration for THIS instance — what directories it scans and what kind of graph each holds. See skills/folio-core/directory-conventions.md. This repo is PRE-SPLIT (issue #223), so it declares what is true today, not the target layout: `tools/` and `folio/` do not exist here yet and are deliberately not declared. A directory that is declared but absent is worse than one that is missing, because every consumer then scans nothing and reports a clean run over it. NOTE: `schemas/` declares TWO graphs — the first real use of the array. A directory is a place to look and may hold more than one part of the graph; it does not say how to tell them apart, because the files declare what they are (see bean xxxb: schemas/*.ts does not yet do this well). `beans/` is declared ONCE, as a single `beans` graph. Its internal split — `defs` for work items, `workflows` for running BPMN state — is declared by `beans/beans.json`, not here. #263 declared the two as separate directories, one nested inside the other, which left a consumer unable to tell which owned what beneath it; the nodes now carry that.
name: folio-assistant

directories.description: Tool definitions — one concrete way to exercise a skill, each naming the skills it satisfies. Authored as .ts calling defineTool so a malformed node fails at tsc; the JSON-LD and JSON Schema renderings are generated.

The content-object model and the per-skill JSON Schemas. Declares BOTH graphs: the schema definitions themselves, and `kg` because a schema IS a knowledge-graph node — the .ts files are part of the KG, not a separate island beside it.

The knowledge graph. Skill packages, and the four other node kinds that point at them: `roles/roles.json` (a role IS a BPMN swimlane, and carries the skills its lane's activities need), `workflows/*.bpmn` + `workflows/decisions/*.dmn` (the processes those roles act in, reached through the skill that describes them), `requirements/*.json` (conformance obligations whose `satisfiedBy` names the skill or capability discharging them), and the `kg-qa/` audit sidecars beside each. Note the id is `kg` while the path is `skills/` — ids are stable across a relocation, paths are not.
The work plan. `beans/beans.json` declares its nodes — `defs` (work items) and `workflows` (running BPMN instance state).
